gap: Discarding a draft is irreversible and leaves no log the agent can read: a discarded draft cannot be recovered or audited through the connector.
abp_impact: A mistaken discard is invisible to the deployer and to the agent's own end of turn report. Drafts are outside the grammar, so the loss cannot even be named as a row.
risk_to_accept: That drafted work disappears without trace. Accepted by the deployer who lets the agent manage drafts.
evidence: The connector's delete_draft tool, which the measured Gmail profile on this site lists on Needs approval; no untrash_draft exists among the thirty.
request: A recoverable trash for drafts, and an audit event when one is discarded.
